title: dactylorhiza majalis subsp. parvimajalis
intro: Dactylorhiza majalis subsp. parvimajalis, commonly known as the small majalis orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid species that belongs to the Dactylorhiza genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza majalis subsp. parvimajalis are attributed to its ability to stimulate blood circulation, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
